name: ssh-mcp
description: Desktop-controlled MCP runtime for human-supervised SSH operations
author: civilization-os contributors

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const dir of ['build','desktop-dist']) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:ui && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:ui: npm --prefix ui install && npm --prefix ui run build
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm --prefix ui exec -- tsc -p ui/tsconfig.app.json --noEmit
